name: Get Net Session (SA)
help: Enumerate network sessions established to a computer using NetSessionEnum
long_help: Uses NetSessionEnum to list network sessions (SMB connections) to the target computer. Shows client IP/hostname, username, active time, and idle time for each session. Useful for identifying who is connected to a file server.

arguments.name: computer
arguments.desc: Target computer to query for sessions (default: local system)
